event_context.title: Bitnami public catalog distribution/support change: versioned images moved to bitnamilegacy, mainline limited to latest-only community tier

evidence_refs.excerpt: As of August 28th, 2025, the Bitnami public catalog will undergo changes: disable Debian-based image generation, move existing versioned tags to Bitnami Legacy repository (docker.io/bitnamilegacy) with no further updates or support; free images limited to latest tag via bitnamisecure; Helm/container source stays Apache-2.0 on GitHub. Deletion postponed to September 29th with brownouts Aug 28, Sep 2, Sep 17.

Upcoming changes to the Bitnami catalog (effective August 28th, 2025): since Aug 28 no new Bitnami container images or Helm charts published to Docker Hub in OCI format; legacy assets archived in Bitnami Legacy repository; public catalog switches to limited community-tier latest-only subset.

Starting August 28th, Bitnami archives its OCI registry to Bitnami Legacy; users must update pipelines/mirrors/clusters. Options: switch to Bitnami Secure Images (recommended, full version support) or Bitnami Legacy (unsupported snapshot, temporary, copy images to own registry).

recommendation.text: Schedule action: migration or upgrade needed before the effective date.
